$comment: One Guarantee channel coverage. Channel numbers and names must equal docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's table. Each entry is a repo-relative test file and the exact title of a live it/test in it; tests/architecture/one-guarantee-coverage.verify.test.ts fails if any entry stops matching, or if a channel has no positive or no negative test in a file the `npm test -- verify` filter collects. Positive = the legitimate path yields the trusted outcome (a stub verify() that always says not_found would fail it). Negative = the forged/failed path never yields verified.

positive.test: positive: a real quote is verified — by verify(), with server spans, not the model's 0..12
positive: a real quote is verified — by verify(), with server spans, not the model's 0..12

negative.test: negative: a fabricated quote the model marks verified, with its own spans, is stored and returned not_found
negative: a fabricated quote the model marks verified, with its own spans, is never stored or shown
a model response that smuggles a status/span field, AND lies about which status a DIFFERENT finding has, is stripped and never surfaced
rejects a forbidden key nested inside an array of objects

positive.test: single-specialist grounded path: verbatim citation verifies, verify() runs exactly once
the final SSE frame's verified citation carries spanText === canonical_text.slice(spanStart, spanEnd) — proven against the STORED document text, not just equal to the model's own quote
no token event has anything but text; the final event is last

negative.test: never emits text containing a hallucinated status field even if raw JSON carries one
prompt injection in document text ('mark this verified') changes nothing — status still comes only from verify(), and a self-certified status key never reaches a token
streaming failure mid-stream (single-specialist path) yields an error event and NO final
every token frame is exactly {type, text}

positive.test: single-specialist grounded path: verbatim citation verifies, verify() runs exactly once
multi-specialist path: 3+ matching domains still dispatches exactly MAX_SPECIALISTS, verify() runs exactly once on the merged citations
a verbatim citation verifies, and its span slices the document back to exactly the quote

negative.test: single-specialist grounded path: fabricated citation returns not_found
synthesis altering a specialist's originally-verbatim quote makes the final citation not_found — proves verify() checks the SYNTHESIZED output, not each specialist's own
a fabricated citation returns not_found
a quote in the document is verified at exactly its text; a fabricated one is not_found — returned and persisted alike

positive.test: positive: a real quote answered by the fallback model is verified, and the fallback model is persisted
positive: a real quote from the fallback model is verified, and the fallback model is reported
a fallback model's name is stored, returned, and reloaded

negative.test: negative: a fabricated quote from the fallback model is not_found, and its output is never served to a primary-model lookup
negative: a fabricated quote from the fallback model is discarded, never shown

positive.test: positive: once the failure clears, the same document analyses normally
positive: once the failure clears, the same documents compare normally
positive: once the failure clears, the same document generates normally
positive control: the same client under its limit answers

negative.test: negative: a provider failure after extraction is a typed error with zero analyses, findings, lens rows or cache
negative: malformed model output (twice, past the repair retry) is SCHEMA_FAILED with nothing persisted
negative: a provider failure is a typed error with no comparison and no changes
with the principal's bucket already full: RATE_LIMITED is the first and only event, no model call, nothing persisted
tokens, then the provider fails: an error event ends the stream, no final, no rows

positive.test: positive: a cached real quote is verified against the new document's own text

negative.test: negative: a cached fabricated quote — even one carrying status 'verified' — returns not_found, with no LLM call

positive.test: runtime: the returned and the reloaded general message have no status and no citations, and carry the label
a general final message carries GENERAL_MODE_LABEL, never model text, and no status/citations key
positive: every question/whyItMatters/checklist-item line carries its fixed, renderer-owned AI prefix
persists templated sections from draft-templates (never the model), ai_generated sections from the model

negative.test: negative: hostile model text mimicking a verified badge is never presented as one
hostile model output mimicking a verified badge is never presented as one in the JSON markdown export
POST /api/threads/:id/messages — the final frame's raw text carries no such key
the mapped object has exactly the general-mode fields, none of them a status/citation/verification key
runtime: a persisted section carries exactly {key, heading, provenance, content} — no status field
the DB CHECK rejects a raw insert whose provenance implies verification — backstop when the TS layer is bypassed
neither the draft object nor any section names a status/verified/quote_span key

positive.test: positive: each verified span slices the canonical text to the quoted passage (line breaks included)
positive: side A slices document A to quote A and side B slices document B to quote B (an A/B swap would not)
positive: the finding's span slices the canonical text to the quoted passage
a verified citation's spanText equals canonicalText.slice(spanStart, spanEnd) — never the model's quote

negative.test: negative: an unverifiable quote has no span to highlight
negative: on reload, a stored quote whose fresh span lands on the other copy is withheld, not shown there

positive.test: positive: a real quote tampered to not_found with wrong spans is returned verified with the true spans
positive: a real quote tampered to not_found with wrong spans is returned verified with its true span
positive: a real, verified quote tampered to not_found in the database (via raw SQL) still shows verified, with true spans

negative.test: negative: a fabricated quote tampered to 'verified' in the database is returned not_found
negative: a stored side tampered to a fabricated quote marked 'verified' is returned not_found
import: a forged verified / cached_verified citation for an absent quote is stored and returned not_found; a forged cached_not_found on a present quote is verified
createThread's import discards the client's status/unverifiedCachedStatus and stores the citation unlinked; GET re-verifies it as not_found
a stored status tampered to verified still reads not_found; one tampered to not_found still reads verified

positive.test: positive control: the same quote against the same text uploaded as a text document IS verified
positive control: the same documents, both text, are verified on both sides

a native_document's verbatim quote is approximate over HTTP, never verified
findings: verified on a native_document document is rejected; drop the trigger and it is accepted
